method: Latest actually captured pre-tipoff projection per game; latest odds-backed capture per game. Each distinct sportsbook/market/player/line/side priced quote is graded independently; positive expected ROI only in summaries. Flat 1-unit hypothetical stake; correlated quotes are not independent bets. No backfill or post-tipoff repricing.

common_cohort.method: All seven models must exist on the same archived forecast or quote. Calibration uses one side per player/market/line (prefer over), excluding pushes. ROI retains all common sportsbook quote sides; correlated lines and books are not independent. V7 is excluded from the common cohort because manual overrides are selective. No historical backfill.

experimental_comparison.method: Prospective same-game, same-player and same archived quote comparisons. Lower MAE/RMSE/Brier/log loss is better. Each model selects its own positive ROI sides from the common quote pool; flat one-unit hypothetical results, correlated quotes not independent. No hindsight or backfilled forecasts. V8, V9 and V10 are paired against V6 to isolate opponent, rotation and probability-distribution adjustments; V11 combines the components and compares against V4, along with the earlier availability/rotation experiments. V4 remains the production control.

closing_line_value.method: First archived positive signal per model, game, player, market, book and side versus the last observed same-book quote. A later snapshot and quote update within 60 minutes of tipoff are required. Same-line CLV is raw implied probability movement in percentage points, not de-vigged EV. Changed-line direction is reported separately and does not account for juice changes. Not verified official closes; missing or stale quotes are excluded from CLV averages. Model signals and books are correlated.
